observations.raw_snippet: A federal judge in San Francisco granted Amazon a preliminary injunction Monday blocking Perplexity from using its Comet browser’s AI agent to access password-protected sections of the Amazon website to shop on behalf of customers.

observations.value_text: A court bars Perplexity's agent from password-protected parts of Amazon's site, stayed for an appeal (Mar 2026)
